feed.title: Soliloquy blog
feed.subtitle: Notes on speaking practice, language learning, and the method behind Soliloquy. No fluent-in-3-months promises, no prices.

entry.title: Language learning for beginners: produce, correct, review
entry.summary: Beginner advice often looks like a shopping list. A better strategy is to produce language, get specific corrections, and review them at the right time.

entry.title: Your first speaking session: how to start without an audience
entry.summary: Your first speaking session does not need an audience or perfect grammar. Here is a small loop you can do alone, today, in about 15 minutes.

entry.title: How to learn words so they stay in your head
entry.summary: Learning more words is not the same as speaking. Here is how to learn words in context, use them in your own sentences, and review them at the right time.

entry.title: How to build a daily speaking habit that survives a busy week
entry.summary: A daily language habit is not about motivation. It is about a small loop you can repeat on a busy day. Here is how to make speaking practice stick.

entry.title: A year of daily speaking practice: what actually changes
entry.summary: A year of daily practice can change how you speak, but nobody can promise a level by a date. Here is what actually changes, and what it takes.
